a6d548.title: Auth/token analysis results (agent 59aa7633)
a6d548.content:
Auth & token surface of super-agent/backend fully assessed. Filed reports:
- vuln-0001 CRITICAL: internal `internal.` tokens signed with public Cognito userPoolId (auth.ts:79-81) — full authn bypass, PoC-verified offline. Same default also = default JWT secret in local mode.
- vuln-0002 CRITICAL: hardcoded default JWT_SECRET 'super-agent-local-dev-secret-change-in-production' (config/index.ts:30), no prod guard; offline JWT forgery PoC. user-data.sh writes CHANGE_ME placeholder.
- vuln-0003 CRITICAL: no rate limit/lockout on /api/auth/login + seeded admin@example.com/admin123 (seed-local-auth.ts:32-33).
- vuln-0004 LOW: ?token= query auth logged in full URL (requestLogger.ts:57; app.ts:54 redact misses query).
- vuln-0006 MEDIUM (conf. medium): Cognito first-login email binding (auth.ts:196-224) reassigns all profile rows without email_verified check — ATO conditional on pool config.
- vuln-0007 MEDIUM: CORS origin:true + credentials:true, default CORS_ORIGIN='*'; no cookie auth so limited today.
- vuln-0008 INFO: a2a.routes.ts:46 compares raw API key against key_hash column (stores sha256) — feature-dead reliability bug, not exploitable.
Clean: apiKey.service.ts (proper sha256 hashing, no enumeration), widget-auth.service.ts (api-key scoped, org-scoped queries), unauthenticated route inventory (health/auth/invite/webhook verify all intentional or guarded).
Open question for others: IM webhook signature verification quality; apps.routes.ts:452-457 mints InsForge JWT with default 'spike-test-secret-key-must-be-32-chars-long' secret (config/index.ts:145) into app .env builds — low impact but same hardcoded-default pattern.

4671c8.title: SSRF/Webhook/Integration agent findings summary (agent ad448eaa)
4671c8.content:
Scope: SSRF, URL fetching, webhooks, integrations, connectors, proxies in super-agent/backend.

Filed reports:
- vuln-0009 (medium): Unrestricted SSRF in workflow api_call action node (action-executor.ts:103-127, workflow-orchestrator.ts:554-560). No URL validation, redirects followed. Includes unauthenticated chain via public webhook trigger + variable substitution. PoC in /tmp/ssrf-poc/api_call_poc.test.js.
- vuln-0010 (medium): SSRF via MCP server test endpoint (mcp.service.ts:276-310) — HEAD fetch of user-supplied host_address/config.url with user-set headers. PoC /tmp/ssrf-poc/mcp_service_poc.test.js.
- vuln-0011 (medium): Webhook secret_hash generated but NEVER verified (no consumer anywhere); public trigger + public /v1/webhook/status/:id state disclosure.
- vuln-0012 (low): OAuth client secrets encrypted with hardcoded default CONNECTOR_ENCRYPTION_KEY + static salt 'salt'; provider upsert has no allowlist.

Clean areas: llm-proxy (Bedrock-only, no user upstream), litellm (server-side config URL), a2a-client remote path (all callers use local:// endpoints — dead code today), api-spec-parser (content-only parse, no URL fetch), avatar/connectors/browser-live-view (no outbound user-URL fetch).

Open gap (needs_follow_up, coverage id 0f0b80): IM adapter verification default-open — DingTalk/Feishu/WhatsApp/Telegram return true when no secret configured; non-timing-safe compares in DingTalk/Feishu; Discord & WeCom generic verifyRequest always true; Slack URL-verification challenge answered before signature check. Could not validate live (needs DB + bindings).

Shared remediation theme: introduce one URL-validation utility (deny loopback/link-local/RFC1918, pin schemes, manual redirects, DNS-pinning) and apply at every user-URL fetch site.

e46f3a.title: FS & command-injection scope results (agent f5512b96)
e46f3a.content:
Scope: filesystem/archive paths, uploads, command execution, workspace mgmt, dev-server, pack deploy, skill install (super-agent/backend).

Confirmed & filed:
- vuln-0013 (high, CVSS 8.8): arbitrary file write via unvalidated skill name — `installSkillToWorkspace`/`downloadSkill` join skill name without containment (workspace-manager.ts:969, 1360); name fully attacker-controlled via `/api/skills/marketplace/upload-zip` zip directory name or installRef. Demonstrated with the real module: wrote /tmp/pwned-by-skill/SKILL.md outside the workspace base. Also escapes S3 per-session prefix (skill-marketplace.routes.ts:197).
- vuln-0014 (high, CVSS 8.8, agentcore mode only): shell injection — skill name interpolated into `runCommand(sessionId, \`mkdir -p /workspace/.claude/skills/${name}\`)` at skill-marketplace.routes.ts:158 and enterprise-skill.service.ts:338; `shellEscape` only escapes quotes/backslashes so `;`/`$()`/backticks pass to `/bin/bash -c`. Demonstrated locally with exact wrapping logic.

Clean (coverage recorded): workspace read/write routes (startsWith guard OK; sibling-prefix theoretical only, all UUIDs), document-groups upload/delete, files.routes S3 prefix checks, pack-deploy (read-only, existsSync-gated), dev-server-manager + plugin git clone (argv arrays, no shell), avatar upload/serve, claude SDK runtime + node-executors (no eval/exec).

Open item: skill-marketplace upload-zip archive handling — classic zip-slip blocked by unzip/tar defaults but symlink-member → fs.cp dereference chain untested; plus `npx skills add` repoRef fetch path (npx-confusion review not performed). Coverage entry 45522a.

Minor reliability notes (not filed): startsWith containment lacks trailing separator throughout workspace-manager; GET /avatars/* lacks authenticate (unauthenticated read of avatar bucket by key).

20873b.title: WS/XSS/Secrets/Dependencies agent — scope coverage summary
20873b.content:
Findings filed: vuln-0020 (WS gateway unauth+unscoped, PoC-confirmed, high), vuln-0021 (fastify CVE family), vuln-0022 (axios via IM SDKs), vuln-0023 (js-yaml in api-spec-parser), vuln-0024 (output-sanitizer redaction gaps, low).

Unverified/notes for other agents:
- IM webhook signature verification fails OPEN when binding config lacks secrets (Slack/Telegram/DingTalk/Feishu adapters return true when internal header absent). WeCom + Discord adapters verifyRequest() always return true. Unauthenticated forged IM messages possible for channels without configured secrets — candidate, not fully validated (would need DB setup).
- Swagger /docs + /documentation exposed unconditionally in production (info-level).
- IM binding config (incl. signing_secret plaintext) returned to any authenticated org member in GET /:scopeId/im-channels response (bot_token masked, config not).
- OAuth callbackHtml postMessage target '*' but only credentialId posted — minor.

Clean: SSE auth/scoping, frontend XSS rendering paths, raw SQL injection, credential vault API masking, gitleaks (1 demo-content hit only), error handler verbosity.
